excluded.adminEarlyAccessList: Internal screeps.com staff tool for the hosted early-access campaign; a standalone server has no hosted applicant list.
excluded.adminEarlyAccessSend: Internal screeps.com staff tool that e-mails hosted early-access invitations; no hosted mail campaign on a standalone server.
excluded.adminTimelineStats: Internal screeps.com staff statistics for hosted shard infrastructure; standalone administration is outside the official contract (server-specific admin API).
excluded.authGithub: GitHub OAuth popup sign-in/linking via the screeps.com GitHub OAuth application and callback; standalone accounts sign in with username/e-mail + password (`POST /api/auth/signin`) or a Steam ticket (`POST /api/auth/steam-ticket`).
excluded.authGithubCheckRepoScope: Checks the scope of a GitHub OAuth authorization; only meaningful with the hosted GitHub OAuth link, which standalone servers do not provide.
excluded.authSteam: Steam OpenID web popup flow bound to screeps.com; standalone servers authenticate Steam users with `POST /api/auth/steam-ticket` (authSteamTicket) instead.
excluded.registerChangePassword: Completes e-mail password recovery with an e-mailed token; requires hosted mail delivery and recovery tokens. Standalone passwords are set by the signed-in player (`POST /api/user/password`) or the server administrator.
excluded.registerConfirm: E-mail address verification link; requires hosted mail delivery.
excluded.registerRecover: Sends a password recovery e-mail; requires hosted mail delivery.
excluded.supportReportProblem: Creates a screeps.com Zendesk support ticket; hosted support service.
excluded.supportSsoJwt: Zendesk single sign-on for the screeps.com forums/support desk; hosted service (also gated on an active subscription).
excluded.userActivateCpuUnlocks: Consumes purchased CPU unlock items (hosted payments/inventory); a standalone server sets CPU limits administratively.
excluded.userActivateShardAccess: Spends access keys for restricted screeps.com shards; multi-shard access does not exist on a single-world server.
excluded.userConvertCreditsSubscription: Converts credits into a paid screeps.com subscription; hosted payments/subscriptions.
excluded.userCpuLimitSet: Credits-charged CPU limit changes tied to the hosted subscription/credits economy; a standalone server sets CPU limits administratively.
excluded.userEarlyPreviewActivate: Hosted World launch activation codes; a standalone world has no early-preview gate.
excluded.userEarlyPreviewRequest: Applies for the hosted early-preview program; no such program on a standalone server.
excluded.userFindShared: `branch: official` alternative: the official client calls `user/find-shared` only when `options.official`; on private servers the replay viewer uses `GET /api/user/find` (userFind, required).
excluded.userGithubRepoSet: GitHub code synchronization runs on screeps.com infrastructure via the hosted GitHub OAuth link; not available without it.
excluded.userGithubRepos: Lists repositories through the hosted GitHub OAuth link; not available without it.
excluded.userIvmSet: Selects between screeps.com's isolated and shared legacy VM runtime pools; a standalone server runs player code in its single operator-configured runtime.
excluded.userNoRateLimit: reCAPTCHA-gated reset of hosted per-token API rate limits; OpenScreeps does not rate-limit its persistent API tokens and has no reCAPTCHA.
excluded.userUnlinkGithub: Removes the hosted GitHub OAuth identity link, which standalone servers do not create.
excluded.userUnlinkSteam: Part of the hosted web identity-linking flow (`GET /api/auth/steam` popup); on a standalone server the Steam identity is the account created by `POST /api/auth/steam-ticket` and is managed by the administrator.

adaptations.userAuthTokenCreate: OpenScreeps creates full-access tokens only: a `type` other than `full` answers `{error: "restricted tokens are not supported"}` and creates no token. The official contract does not establish how screeps.com enforces restricted endpoints, websockets and Memory segments, and a full-access token would grant more than the request asks for.

notes.userAuthTokenCreate: `type` absent or `full` creates a full-access token; `endpoints`, `websockets` and `memorySegments` are then ignored, as the official form posts them with every request. An optional `description` must be a string of at most 100 characters (`invalid params` otherwise). The reply's `token` is a random UUID, shown only this once: the server stores a SHA-256 hash of it and its first 8 characters. The token never expires and is never rotated: responses to requests that it authenticates carry no `X-Token`, and the socket's `auth ok` returns it unchanged. It is accepted wherever session tokens are: the `X-Token` header, `Authorization: Bearer`, the `token` query parameter and the socket `auth` command. An account holds at most 100 tokens (`too many tokens`). Deleting the account removes its tokens.
notes.userAuthTokenDelete: `tokenId` is the `_id` of one of the caller's tokens from `GET /api/user/auth-token`; an unknown id or a token of another account answers `{error: "token not found"}`. The deletion takes effect at once: later requests with the token answer HTTP 401, and socket sessions authenticated with it are closed.
notes.userAuthTokenList: Lists the caller's persistent API tokens, oldest first. Each entry holds `_id`, `token` (the first 8 characters of the token), `full` (always `true`) and `description` (`null` when none). Entries never carry `noRatelimitUntil`: OpenScreeps does not rate-limit API tokens.
notes.userPasswordSet: Standalone servers sign players in with username or e-mail plus password (`POST /api/auth/signin`); this operation changes that local password. OpenScreeps revokes the account's session tokens and closes its authenticated socket sessions whenever a password changes, so the client must sign in again afterwards. Persistent API tokens (`POST /api/user/auth-token`) stay valid until they are deleted.
notes.userMoneyHistoryDetails: A single world serves the details from its own money ledger (the entries listed by `GET /api/user/money-history`), resolving the counterparties of a market deal by `tick`, `roomName` and `targetRoomName`; the official market history page calls it without an `options.official` branch.
